title: org.kde.plasma.activitybar - support for stopped activities and activity icons
line: The Activities bar widget now shows each activity's icon next to its name.
explanation: The Activities bar's tabs only had text, so the icon set for each activity in System Settings never appeared there. The model already provides it (iconSource, with the generic activities icon as fallback). The change sets it as the tab button's icon and counter-rotates the icon when the bar is turned sideways on a vertical panel, so it stays upright like in other vertical tab bars.

commits.message:
applets/activitybar: show activity icons

The Activities bar only showed the name of each activity, so the icon
chosen for it in the Activities settings was nowhere to be seen. Show it
next to the name, and keep it upright when the bar is on a vertical panel.

BUG: 355775

patches.diff:
From a7bd6fe0a0eafb0b42e5114085acfb64816df545 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:14:49 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/activitybar: show activity icons

The Activities bar only showed the name of each activity, so the icon
chosen for it in the Activities settings was nowhere to be seen. Show it
next to the name, and keep it upright when the bar is on a vertical panel.

BUG: 355775
---
 applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml | 9 +++++++++
 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml b/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml
index cd66621029..0a5dd80564 100644
--- a/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml
@@ -67,12 +67,14 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 required property bool current
                 required property string name
                 required property string id
+                required property string iconSource
 
                 topPadding: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
                 bottomPadding: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
 
                 checked: current
                 text: name
+                icon.name: iconSource
                 activeFocusOnTab: true
                 width: implicitWidth
                 height: tabBar.contentHeight
@@ -88,6 +90,13 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                         break;
                     }
                 }
+                // The whole tab bar is rotated in vertical panels, keep the icons upright
+                Binding {
+                    target: tab.contentItem
+                    property: "iconItem.rotation"
+                    value: -tabBar.rotation
+                }
+
                 Accessible.checked: current
                 Accessible.name: name
                 Accessible.description: i18n("Switch to activity %1", name)
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Bottom panel: tabs show names only
Bottom panel: each tab shows its activity's icon
Left panel: icons stay upright next to the rotated names
